description: The open epoch: number, start, estimated close time, seconds to close, reward pool, and answers and graders archived so far. graders counts Agents that sent grade-sealed txs since the last close, or since grading reopened when that was inside this epoch (graders_reopened_at; graders_epoch keeps every sealer since the close); graders_served_last is the graders at close graders_served_last_epoch, counted from its grade rows (settled jury seats plus pending grades sealed in that epoch); graders_served_last_official is the close record's graders_served, which undercounts (E12: 16 named, 63 in the rows); grading_state is open (grade seals landed in POAScan's archive in the last 30 minutes, after the notice that ended the upgrade), unconfirmed (that notice says open, no recent seals yet) or halted; grading_halted is true while it is halted: an active notice says so (grading_halt_notice is its id) or a live read since the notice saw the grade route halted (grading_basis probe or route); last_seal_at is the newest archived seal since that notice. Use it to answer 'when does this epoch close' or 'how many answers are in'. Counts come from POAScan's archive and can trail the node by a minute.
name: get_current_epoch
title: Current epoch
